title: Conflict Analysis: SurrealDB Official Library Integration
description: Analysis of conflicts and overlaps between SurrealDB Official Library Integration and other specifications in the system

Changed from sync to async (get_surreal_client() now async)
Added merge() method for partial updates
Added health_check() method
Added _execute_with_retry() with exponential backoff
Connection retry logic for transient failures

The async changes from spec 1 will require spec 2's Redis cache code to also be async.

conflicts.description: Both specifications modify update_metrics_after_execution(). Spec 1 changes it to async and uses merge(). Spec 2 wants to add Redis cache updates. The changes are compatible but must be applied in order.
conflicts.impact: If spec 2 is enforced before spec 1 completes, Redis cache code will use sync db operations and update() instead of merge(), breaking the bug fix.

steps: 2. Update surrealdb-primary-redis-cache enforcement plan to account for async changes
3. Add Redis cache updates to async update_metrics_after_execution() using merge()
4. Ensure Redis cache operations are also async

technicalDetails.spec1Changes:
async def update_metrics_after_execution(...) -> ...
    ...
    result = await db.merge(record_id, update_data)  # Changed from update()
technicalDetails.spec2DesiredChanges:
async def update_metrics_after_execution(...) -> ...
    ...
    result = await db.merge(record_id, update_data)
    # ADD THIS:
    await update_redis_cache(template_id, result)
technicalDetails.mergedImplementation: Combine both: use merge() for SurrealDB, then update Redis cache

conflicts.description: Making get_surreal_client() async is a BREAKING CHANGE that affects all code using the database client. All callers must add 'await'.
conflicts.impact: Any specification that uses database operations will break until updated to use async/await.

steps: 1. Audit all db operation modules for sync calls
2. Update each module to async (estimated 8+ files)
3. Update all route handlers to await db operations
4. Run comprehensive tests to catch missed async conversions
resolution.blocker: Cannot fully deploy surrealdb-official-library-integration until this is complete

technicalDetails.beforeChange:
db = get_surreal_client()  # Sync call
result = db.query(...)
technicalDetails.afterChange:
db = await get_surreal_client()  # Async call
result = await db.query(...)

conflicts.description: surrealdb-official-library-integration requires SurrealDB v3.0+ for compatibility. surrealdb-primary-redis-cache assumes SurrealDB is available. Both specs are blocked by the same deployment requirement.
conflicts.impact: Cannot test or validate either specification until SurrealDB is upgraded from v2.3.10 to v3.0+

steps: 1. Upgrade SurrealDB deployment: kubectl set image deployment/surrealdb surrealdb=surrealdb/surrealdb:v3.0 -n metabob
3. Verify auth works with official library
4. Run validation harnesses for both specs
